message.jaymoskingdoms.title.earned: A name is made for you: %1$s. Wear it on the H menu's Titles page.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.title.greet.1: They say you are %1$s. I did not believe it till I saw you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.title.greet.2: %1$s, here, among us. Mind the children; they will want to stare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.title.greet.3: Good day to you, %1$s. Your name goes ahead of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.gear.demands.migh: %1$s is too heavy for you yet: it swings badly without %2$s Might.
message.jaymoskingdoms.gear.demands.agil: You cannot draw %1$s full without %2$s Agility: the shot goes short.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stormwyrm.desc: The blood of the storm dragons, Eurus and Aeolus: violet scales that spark in thunder.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.venomscale.desc: The blood of the acid dragons, Zephyrus and Varasuchus: green scales that weep a sour sweat.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.gift: Gift: lightning does you 60% less harm; the more gold you carry, the harder you hit (up to 15% with a stack of ingots)
Gift: no poison takes you; the more gold you carry, the harder you hit (up to 15% with a stack of ingots)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.storm_breath.des: a cone of crackling sparks ahead that slows what they strike (30 s)
kit.jaymoskingdoms.move.acid_breath.desc: a cone of acid spray ahead that poisons what it touches (30 s)
feat.jaymoskingdoms.everybodys_friend.de: A settlement that does not know you yet warms to you half again as fast: every good word and deed counts one and a half times, until you are well liked there.
feat.jaymoskingdoms.skybound.desc: In the Aether you stand steady: you can fall twelve blocks further unhurt and a blow shoves you far less.
class.jaymoskingdoms.artificer.desc: A maker who works gear in the hand. Press your class key with a weapon or armour in the main hand to reforge it for two amethyst shards (its quality is rolled anew, airy or fiery, and a tenth of its wear mended); sneak and press it with blaze powder or feathers in the off hand to infuse it. Sneak and use a cauldron of water with a glass bottle in your hand and a reagent in the other to brew an elixir that no one else knows how to make. An armourer or a cleric of the village teaches the trade.
message.jaymoskingdoms.artificer.begin: Gear is only a first draft. Hold a piece and press your class key.
message.jaymoskingdoms.artificer.no_gear: Hold a weapon or a piece of armour in your main hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.artificer.reagent: An infusion takes %s blaze powder (for fire) or feathers (for air) in your off hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.artificer.no_reag: A reagent in your off hand: blaze powder, a golden carrot, a phantom membrane or a glistering melon slice.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.art_keen.desc: A reforge is 15% likelier, a rank, to roll a grade higher.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.art_deep.desc: An infusion goes a grade deeper.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.art_long.desc: Your elixirs last half as long again, a rank.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.art_twice.desc: Two bottles in hand, two elixirs from one pour.
classtree.jaymoskingdoms.art_mending.des: A reforge mends two fifths of what the gear has lost, not a tenth.
quality.jaymoskingdoms.air: %s airy: a blow lifts the foe; worn, it softens a fall
quality.jaymoskingdoms.fire: %s fiery: a blow sets the foe alight; worn, it dulls fire
message.jaymoskingdoms.salvage.worthless: Not worth the fire: wood, stone and hide do not melt for a smith.
message.jaymoskingdoms.salvage.done: The smith melts it down and hands you %1$s %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.named.already: That one already has a name.
message.jaymoskingdoms.named.most: You cannot keep faith with more than %s named followers.
message.jaymoskingdoms.named.done: You call it %s. It will grow for you, and it costs you strength for %s days.
message.jaymoskingdoms.named.settled: %s has settled the town of %s: a named follower keeps the peace.
You wake small and green in the grass, with a bone in each hand and a hunger that is not a person's. Something has made you one of the goblin people. Name a follower and it will grow; so will you.
You wake among stones, scaled and low, with a bone in each hand. Something has made you a kobold of the hills. Name a follower and it will grow; so will you.
You wake wet and clear by the water, a body of gel with a bone floating in each hand. Something has made you slime-born. Name a follower and it will grow; so will you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feast.nothing: You eat it, and learn nothing from it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feast.known: You already know the trick of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.throne.not_yet: The tribes do not bow yet: %s of %s stand with you (goblins and orcs both).
message.jaymoskingdoms.throne.taken: The tribes bow to %s, sovereign of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.none: You have slain nothing that could fight for you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.pick: The rite will call the shade of: %s
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.quiet: The shades have not settled yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.crowded: No more than %s shades can stand at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.shade.too_great: What you slew was too great to call back.
shade.jaymoskingdoms.name: Shade of %s
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monsterborn.ta: You died, and what woke was not a person. The goblin people took you in as one of their own, or the kobolds of the hills, or the gel of the water, and you have a bone in each hand and a hunger to learn what you eat.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monsterborn.sh: Woke as a monster, and growing.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monsterborn.wa: You wake as one of the goblin people, in the form the land gives you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monsterborn.hi: Someone has to name a follower and make it grow first.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monsterborn.0: You smell of bone and old grass. You are not from any camp I know.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monsterborn.1: They say something wakes in the wild and is not a person. Are you it?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monsterborn.2: Small and strange, and you keep growing. I have seen it before. Be careful what you eat.
aim.jaymoskingdoms.monsterborn.title: the Grown
